# watchpoint_invitation (Resource)

Invites a user to the tenant by email. The invitation cannot be edited in place; changing the email replaces it. Deleting the resource revokes the invitation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_invitation" "example" {
  email = "newuser@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address to invite.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Acceptance timestamp (RFC 3339), if accepted.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Invitation ID.
- `invited_by_user_id` (String) ID of the user who sent the invitation.
- `status` (String) Invitation status (`Pending`, `Accepted`, `Expired`, `Revoked`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_invitation.example inv_001
```
